name: vscode-project-helper
description: Helps Codex inspect, explain, debug, and improve projects available in the active local workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Understand and improve your local project
interface.longDescription: Inspect, explain, debug, and improve project files available in the active workspace. Works with VS Code projects when their files are accessible to Codex.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect the project available in my workspace, explain its structure, and help me improve it safely.
